notes: ISTEP+ three-level scheme (Did Not Pass / Pass / Pass +) after the 2015 college-and-career-ready standards reset. ISTEP / ISTEP+ / ILEARN tested grades start at 3. The filed-not-fixed grade-encoding-split analysis (K vs 0) does not apply. Grade 10 ISTEP+ ELA/Mathematics appear in 2017–2018; those cuts are on a separate hundreds-scale (not the 3–8 scale).
